name: Yang2006
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">

  <RD format_version="3">
  
    <description>
        Lingfa Yang, Anatol M. Zhabotinsky and Irving R. Epstein (2006) "Jumping solitary waves in an 
        autonomous reaction–diffusion system with subcritical wave instability"
        <a href="http://hopf.chem.brandeis.edu/pubs/pub325%20rep.pdf">PDF</a>
        
        "Here we present a new type of solitary traveling
        waves, which we call jumping oscillons (JO). They propagate
        in such a manner that the pulse periodically disappears and
        then reemerges at a fixed distance from its previous position.
        Thus, in a co-moving frame, the wave looks like a stationary
        oscillon."
    </description>
    
    <rule name="Yang2006" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
      <param name="D_a">         1.0         </param>
      <param name="D_b">         1.0         </param>
      <param name="D_c">         60.0        </param>
      <param name="k1">          -8.5        </param>
      <param name="k3">          10.0        </param>
      <param name="k4">          2.0         </param>
      <param name="tau">         50.0        </param>
      <param name="dx">          0.5         </param>
      <param name="timestep">    0.001       </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="3">
        delta_a = D_a * laplacian_a / (dx*dx) + k1 + 2.0f*a - a*a*a - k3*b - k4*c;
        delta_b = D_b * laplacian_b / (dx*dx) + ( a - b ) / tau;
        delta_c = D_c * laplacian_c / (dx*dx) + a - c;
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
    
    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="true">

      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite />
        <constant value="-0.8" />
        <everywhere/>
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite />
        <constant value="0.0" />
        <rectangle>
          <point3d x="0.5" y="0" z="0" />
          <point3d x="0.6" y="0.2" z="0.2" />
        </rectangle>
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite />
        <constant value="-1.2" />
        <rectangle>
          <point3d x="0.4" y="0" z="0" />
          <point3d x="0.5" y="0.2" z="0.2" />
        </rectangle>
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="b">
        <overwrite />
        <constant value="-0.8" />
        <everywhere/>
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="b">
        <overwrite />
        <constant value="-0.73" />
        <rectangle>
          <point3d x="0.4" y="0" z="0" />
          <point3d x="0.5" y="0.2" z="0.2" />
        </rectangle>
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="c">
        <overwrite />
        <constant value="-0.8" />
        <everywhere/>
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="c">
        <overwrite />
        <constant value="-0.68" />
        <rectangle>
          <point3d x="0.5" y="0" z="0" />
          <point3d x="0.6" y="0.2" z="0.2" />
        </rectangle>
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="c">
        <overwrite />
        <constant value="-0.95" />
        <rectangle>
          <point3d x="0.2" y="0" z="0" />
          <point3d x="0.5" y="0.2" z="0.2" />
        </rectangle>
      </overlay>
     
    </initial_pattern_generator>
    
    <render_settings>
      <low value="-1.5" />
      <high value="1.5" />
      <show_displacement_mapped_surface value="false" />
      <timesteps_per_render value="64" />
      <show_multiple_chemicals value="true" />
      <contour_level value="-0.75" />
      <show_color_scale value="false" />
      <vertical_scale_1D value="100" />
    </render_settings>
    
  </RD>
  <ImageData WholeExtent="0 255 0 0 0 0"></ImageData>
</VTKFile>
